description: Evolve activities by merging, refining, or separating based on performance data

task_steps.title: Review Activity Performance
task_steps.description: Analyze performance across all active activities
guidance: Look for activities with overlapping scope
Find activities that are too broad or too narrow

task_steps.title: Identify Evolution Opportunity
task_steps.description: Determine what type of evolution is needed
guidance: MERGE: Combine similar activities with overlapping success
REFINE: Improve a single activity based on learnings
SEPARATE: Split an overly broad activity into focused ones

task_steps.title: Plan Evolution
task_steps.description: Design the target state for the evolution
guidance: Preserve successful patterns from source activities

task_steps.title: Execute Evolution
task_steps.description: Create new activities and deprecate old ones
guidance: Update any references to evolved activities

task_steps.title: Validate Evolution
guidance: Document the evolution for future reference
